label: Qwen3.5 4B (local)
serve: Ollama (0.31.1): `ollama pull qwen3.5:4b` (3.3 GB, Q4_K_M, vision, tools and thinking), then the Ollama server answers /v1/chat/completions on its own port. See docs/local-models.md.
notes: Probed 2026-11-14 with pc/tools/probe_model.py. A THINKING model: with its reasoning on, a sheet call spends about 3,000 tokens and returns an EMPTY reply after 15 to 40 s, and reasoning_effort low or medium change nothing; only extra_body reasoning_effort none gives an answer (0.4 to 3 s), and think: false does nothing. With reasoning off it takes the 1344 px sheet, but the JSON constraint is not applied: replies come in code fences and the overview schema fitted 7 of 8 calls while the events schema fitted 0 of 8 (fields missing), so the events call will be left out; json_object and prompt-only did no better. The server returns tool calls (8 of 8, with sloppy arguments: empty or stray list items, once a string for the list), but supports_tools is false: agent-core's model client takes no extra_body, so the ReAct agent cannot switch the reasoning off, the model thinks, and the agent got no script in 9 of 9 runs (eval/spike/commentator_qwen3-5-4b-local_agent.md); the Commentator uses the structured draft instead, which does carry the switch. Six calls at once took 1.4 s against 2.5 s in a row, so max_parallel is 6. detail is accepted and ignored, so it is not sent.
